faq.headline: The questions people in the queue keep asking.

legal.q: Is it legal to email someone you don't know?
legal.a: Yes, in the context of relevant B2B outreach. GDPR allows contacting a professional email under legitimate interest, which applies to internship and apprenticeship search. Cheatjob doesn't store an email database. Addresses are reconstructed in real time from public information. Every message you send includes the required opt-out option.

robot.q: Will the recruiter know it's a bot?
robot.a: No. Cheatjob writes a first draft that you read, edit, and approve before sending. You're the one sending, from your own inbox. You stay the author of the message. And honestly, nobody writes a cold email from scratch in 2026, not even sales people.

early.q: If I land my apprenticeship in 2 weeks, can I stop?
early.a: Yes. The Sprint plan ends automatically after 30 days, no renewal. The Monthly plan cancels in one click from your dashboard. The Lifetime plan has no renewal.

contracts.q: What kind of contracts does this work for?
contracts.a: End-of-studies internships, apprenticeships (apprentissage and contrat pro), first full-time roles for new grads. Templates are tuned to the French student market. The method also works for summer jobs, but that's not our specialty.

sender.q: Which address does my email send from?
sender.a: From your personal address, via your connected Gmail or Outlook inbox. Cheatjob never sends anything on behalf of an intermediary domain. Your identity stays yours, that's the only way not to land in spam.

bts.q: I'm a BTS student in bac+2, is this for me?
bts.a: Yes. BTS students make up about a third of our audience. Templates work for short mandatory internships and long apprenticeships alike.
